summary: Wallowa County, OR lookout: tower built 1933 (design disputed), known lookouts 1936-1946, removed or destroyed in the 1970s; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Disputed: register gives a 94' treated timber L-6 tower with cabin, cut to 72' in 1955; firelookout.com gives a 30' pole L-4 tower
facts.agency: Wallowa National Forest (Forest Lookouts); Wallowa-Whitman National Forest (firelookout.com)
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in the 1970s; no source read describes what remains on the summit

events.note: Note found on the cabin wall, dated 1923; the Forest Lookouts page says the lookout was a retired sheepman
Tower built in 1933; the register gives a 94-foot L-6 with cabin, firelookout.com a 30-foot pole L-4

notes_for_editor: Probably the same peak as us-or-nebo-peak (Nebo Peak Lookout Site, US 1128); the two records' coordinates are roughly 4 km apart, so a merge needs a human decision. Design, forest name and removal vs destruction all conflict between sources and are left open. The removal year is only given as the 1970s, so the event year 1970 is a placeholder for the decade. The record's agency 'Wallowa National Forest' is one of two names in the sources. No source describes the site or access today.
